#!/usr/bin/env python3

import sys
import os

# Add Django to the path
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

import django
from django.conf import settings

# Configure Django settings
if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(
        INSTALLED_APPS=[
            'django.contrib.contenttypes',
            'django.contrib.auth',
        ],
        DATABASES={
            'default': {
                'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
                'NAME': ':memory:',
            }
        },
        USE_TZ=True,
    )

django.setup()

from django.db import models, migrations
from django.db.migrations.optimizer import MigrationOptimizer

def test_addfield_alterfield_optimization():
    print("Testing AddField + AlterField optimization...")
    
    optimizer = MigrationOptimizer()
    
    # Test the original example from the PR
    operations = [
        migrations.AddField(
            model_name="book",
            name="title",
            field=models.CharField(max_length=256, null=True),
        ),
        migrations.AlterField(
            model_name="book",
            name="title",
            field=models.CharField(max_length=128, null=True),
        ),
        migrations.AlterField(
            model_name="book",
            name="title",
            field=models.CharField(max_length=128, null=True, help_text="help"),
        ),
        migrations.AlterField(
            model_name="book",
            name="title",
            field=models.CharField(max_length=128, null=True, help_text="help", default=None),
        ),
    ]
    
    result = optimizer.optimize(operations, "books")
    print(f"Original: {len(operations)} operations -> Optimized: {len(result)} operations")
    
    # Should be reduced to just one AddField with the final field configuration
    assert len(result) == 1, f"Expected 1 operation, got {len(result)}"
    assert isinstance(result[0], migrations.AddField), f"Expected AddField, got {type(result[0])}"
    
    # Check that the final field has all the properties from the last AlterField
    final_field = result[0].field
    assert final_field.max_length == 128, f"Expected max_length=128, got {final_field.max_length}"
    assert final_field.null == True, f"Expected null=True, got {final_field.null}"
    assert final_field.help_text == "help", f"Expected help_text='help', got {final_field.help_text}"
    assert final_field.default == None, f"Expected default=None, got {final_field.default}"
    
    print("✓ PASS: AddField + multiple AlterField correctly reduced to single AddField")
    return True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    success = test_addfield_alterfield_optimization()
    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)
